notes.title: Follow Mode Update
notes.content: Two more levels have been added to the follow game mode, guide the robots through the map, get them to the other side of the map, in this exciting game mode.

notes.title: Added Game Mode Follow
notes.content: Added a game mode called Follow, you have five robots following you and you have to guide them through the city and make sure they get to the end of the level. Guide the robots pass the obstacles and battle enemies in two levels.

notes.title: fixes and instructions
notes.content: added some intructions to help people understand game modes better and fixed some scoring issues and other fixes

notes.title: added a gamemode called abduction and other fixes
notes.content: added a game mode called abduction you start in a spaceship, the aliens have put you in a simulation try and break out of the space ship while collecting five newspapers.

notes.title: gameplay improvements and bug fixes
notes.content: improved gameplay making it faster and fixed some bugs
